web_banner.tagline: Give Mom the Gift of Beauty
web_banner.body: Up to 25% off skincare, fragrance, and cosmetics. Free gift with $75+ purchase.
web_banner.visual_direction: Hero shot of a curated gift set on soft pink linen, warm natural lighting with fresh peonies as accent — evoke the feeling of an unwrapped present.

email.tagline: She Gave You Everything. Give Her Beauty.
email.body: This Mother's Day, treat her to the beauty she deserves. Enjoy up to 25% off premium skincare, fragrance, and cosmetics — plus a free gift with purchases of $75 or more. Star Rewards members get free shipping on Beauty orders over $50.
email.visual_direction: Clean editorial layout with a product flatlay of top skincare and fragrance picks, soft gradient background shifting from blush to cream, with a personal handwritten-style header font.

mobile.tagline: Beauty for Mom. Up to 25% Off.
mobile.body: Skincare, fragrance, and cosmetics she'll love. Free gift with $75+ purchase.
mobile.visual_direction: Single hero product image on a clean white background, bold typography, thumb-friendly CTA button in Macy's red.

in_store_signage.body: Up to 25% off. Free gift with $75+ purchase.
in_store_signage.visual_direction: Large lifestyle image of a woman receiving a wrapped beauty gift, warm tones, minimal text overlay so the visual carries the emotional weight at a distance.
